issues.reason: Categorical statements bars it outright — "a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol … a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself (its size, its name)" — and being ground holds of each feather, so the descriptive (non-classifying, hence unfused) modifier must go through the distributive rule.

defect_summary: Compliant form: replace (Member sk_feathers_1 ground) with the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_feathers_1) (Member $x ground)) (STV 1.0 0.9), keeping the GroupOf witness, the Instrument link and everything else unchanged.
notes: The rest is right: "ward back" kept whole as a phrasal verb with no genus, the episodic bare-plural subject minting a group witness, Theme for the displaced wraith, and Instrument for the means. The reviewer's open question — whether "ward back" is distributive enough to also add a per-member rule on sk_keepers_1 — is a genuine judgment call the instruction set leaves to the distributive/collective test, not a defect.
